edges.mechanism: Berberine inhibits CYP3A4 (and intestinal P-gp), raising cyclosporine exposure: trough +29.3% vs controls, AUC +34.5%, Cmin +88.3%, CL/F -40.4% in renal-transplant recipients.
edges.evidence: Human RCT (n=104) plus PK substudy (n=6); rat P-gp data; DDI review names it the clinical anchor interaction

edges.mechanism: Sirolimus is a narrow-therapeutic-index CYP3A4/P-gp substrate; berberine inhibits CYP3A4 in humans (midazolam AUC +40%) and P-gp in rats, so sirolimus levels may rise.
edges.evidence: Inferred from human CYP3A4 probe study and cyclosporine data; no direct sirolimus study; low certainty

edges.mechanism: CYP3A4/P-gp substrate with narrow therapeutic index; berberine CYP3A4 inhibition expected to raise levels.
edges.evidence: Inferred from human CYP3A4 and cyclosporine data; review flags immunosuppressants as high-risk victims; no direct study

edges.mechanism: Berberine 300 mg three times daily for 2 wk raised midazolam AUC 40%, Cmax 38%, and cut oral clearance 27%; goldenseal raised midazolam AUC GMR 1.43.
edges.evidence: Human randomized crossover PK study; goldenseal cocktail study

edges.mechanism: Quasi-irreversible CYP2D6 inhibition: urinary dextromethorphan/dextrorphan ratio rose 9-fold; nebivolol clearance reduced in microsomes.
edges.evidence: Human PK study plus human liver microsome kinetics

edges.mechanism: CYP2C9 inhibition: losartan/E-3174 ratio doubled after 2 wk berberine 900 mg/d.
edges.evidence: Human randomized crossover PK study

edges.mechanism: Intestinal P-gp inhibition increased oral digoxin AUC 23-70% and cyclosporine AUC 62-96% in rats.
edges.evidence: Animal PK; human data only for cyclosporine

edges.mechanism: Additive glucose lowering (berberine with hypoglycemics: HbA1c MD -0.69%); goldenseal (berberine-rich) lowered metformin AUC 23% in healthy adults but not meaningfully in T2D (GMR 0.93).
edges.evidence: MA of RCTs; human PK studies with goldenseal (not purified berberine); hypoglycemia not significantly increased in MA

edges.mechanism: Additive glucose lowering with oral hypoglycemics; shared alpha-glucosidase target suggested only computationally (weaker binding than acarbose).
edges.evidence: MA of combination RCTs; in-silico docking; no direct combination study

edges.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic additivity; reviews list hypoglycemia as an interaction axis although MA found no significant hypoglycemia increase (RR 0.48, CI 0.21-1.08).
edges.evidence: MAs of RCTs; narrative DDI review

edges.mechanism: Complementary LDLR mRNA stabilization mechanism; berberine+simvastatin lowered TG and TC more than simvastatin alone; no PK interaction with simvastatin in healthy subjects.
edges.evidence: MA of 11 RCTs; open-label randomized PK study (n=60); mechanistic study

edges.mechanism: Additive LDL lowering: berberine+red yeast rice combinations lowered LDL ~19-27 mg/dL; garlic also lowers LDL. Theoretical rise in monacolin K (CYP3A4 substrate) exposure via berberine CYP3A4 inhibition.
edges.evidence: MAs of combination RCTs and nutraceutical NMA; CYP3A4 point is inferred, not studied

edges.mechanism: Both lower LDL-C vs placebo in a network meta-analysis; additive lipid lowering plausible.
edges.evidence: Indirect NMA evidence; no combination trial

edges.mechanism: Case of QT prolongation and torsades de pointes with cardiac arrest attributed to berberine; QT prolongation listed as a pharmacodynamic interaction axis.
edges.evidence: Single case report plus narrative review; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Berberine displaces bilirubin from albumin (~10x phenylbutazone) and raised unbound bilirubin in rats; kernicterus risk for the fetus/newborn; NCCIH advises against goldenseal in pregnancy.
edges.evidence: In vitro/animal data and official guidance; no human pregnancy safety data

edges.mechanism: Bilirubin displacement risk to the nursing neonate; milk transfer unknown; LactMed and NCCIH recommend avoidance.
edges.evidence: Official guidance (LactMed, NCCIH) based on mechanistic data

edges.mechanism: Displaces bilirubin from albumin, increasing unbound bilirubin and kernicterus risk in jaundiced newborns.
edges.evidence: In vitro and rat data; reported kernicterus concern with huanglian in jaundiced infants

edges.mechanism: Raises calcineurin-inhibitor exposure through CYP3A4/P-gp inhibition; requires drug-level monitoring.
edges.evidence: Human RCT in renal-transplant recipients

edges.mechanism: Physiological (not analytical) effect: displacement from albumin raises unbound and total bilirubin in rats.
edges.evidence: Animal and in vitro data

edges.mechanism: Trough cyclosporine rises with berberine co-administration; true pharmacokinetic effect, not assay interference.
edges.evidence: Human RCT
